bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the demographic distribution of synthetic personas during dataset generation and applying hash-based diversity re-mapping to ensure balanced representation across 9 distinct ethnicity groups.
Analyzing the location grounding of generated profiles and using region-specific override rates to adjust sampling, guaranteeing diverse representation across different countries and cities.
Mitigating occupational and cultural stereotypes during persona completion by intentionally marking gender as 'unknown' unless it is explicitly stated in the initial seed description.

Acknowledging and qualitatively assessing the 'real-to-sim' gap where the benchmark inevitably inherits stylistic and cultural biases from the underlying family of image generator models used to create the synthetic personas.
